The '''''Harasser''''' [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] consisted of two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]]&mdash;designated '''''Harasser 1''''' and '''''Harasser 2'''''&mdash;that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were part of a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']] during [[Operation Strike Fear]]. While mustering in the [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]], the ''Harasser'' group was identified by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] reconnaissance mission flown by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in a lone [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]].

==Characteristics==
Both ''Harasser 1'' and ''Harasser 2'' were fitted with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries and [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]], and were painted the standard [[gray]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] and marked with two small [[white]] Imperial emblems on each side of the bow and one small [[white]] one on each side of the stern of each ship.

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Child of Light]]'' [[roleplaying game]] adventure written by [[Lee Pickler]] and released by the [[RPGA]] on behalf of [[Wizards of the Coast]], a ''Harasser'' group Nebulon-B escort frigate enters the [[Dalicron system/Legends|Dalicron system]] and places it under quarantine while the player characters are attempting to take a strongly [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child, named [[Caeleb]], into Alliance protection.

The ''Harasser'' [[Battle group/Legends|group]] was represented by a single Nebulon-B frigate miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''. The fact that a single unit is labeled ''Harasser''&mdash;rather than two separate ships separately identified as ''Harasser 1'' and ''Harasser 2''&mdash;is irrelevant due to the allowance of the use of multiple copies of units by a player in the game.
